tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sa skya pa'i bka' srung rnams kyi bskang gso mnyes byed 'chi med sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra ma hā kā la s+ya pū ri ka shwa sa na rak+ṣi ko pa ka ro3mṛ ta ti la ka hā la/ bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i bskang ba bstan srung mnyes byed bdud rtsi'i thig le zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog dang thun mong bde blag tu/ /stsol mdzad bla ma mchog rnams dang / /lhag pa'i lha dang bstan srung gtso/ /nag po che la rab btud nas/ /de mnyes byed pa'i cho ga dag /dam pa snga mas mang gsung mod/ slar yang thugs dam bskang ba'i thabs/ dang po'i blo can don du bri/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lcam dral 'khor bcas dang / gnyan mgon chen po zhal bzhi pa sogs/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i phyag len ltar/ srung ma'i dbang po rnams kyi thugs dam bskang bar 'dod na/ gnas khang gtsang zhing yid du 'ong bar/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong gi rten legs par bzhugs pa'i mdun du/ stegs mtho ba la gtor ma rnams la kha rlangs dang grib ma ma phog cing / rgyu bzang la gtsang sbra che bar nang gi mdo phugs dang bstun/ gral rim bzhin bkod pa'i mdun du yang / bskang ba'i gtor ma rnams dbyibs zur gsum la mar gyis rgyan phyag mtshan gyi rnam par byas pa dang / sha mar thud bu ram sogs kha zas bzang dgus bskor ba lag len bzhin bshams/ gzhan yang bla bre 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan go khrag stag gzig gos dar ja sogs dang / bya rta g.yag lug khyi dre'u bong bu rnams dngos sam/ gzugs brnyan bcos la/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pa lnga/ rol mo'i rigs rnga sil snyan rkang dung la sogs pa dgos pa'i yo byad dang / tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i yo byad phyi dang nang gi bza' btung / gu gul la sbyar ba'i bdug spos rdo rje dril bu ḍa ma ru sogs ma tshang ba med pa bkod pa mdzes shing rngam brjid che ba bya/

rnal 'byor pa rnams gral la 'khod nas/ kye rdor/ bde mchog phur pa gang rung gi bdag bskyed sngon du song rjes/ yi dam chos skyong gi gtor ma dkyus bzhin phul/ bzlas brjod dang bshags pa byas la bskang rdzas rnams la dmigs nas/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang drag po'i gzhal yas khang mi mgo skam po'i rtsig pa dang / rgyu ma'i dra phyed 'phyang ba/ bse smug po'i sgo can/ steng du zhing chen gyi bla bre dang / mi ro'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che bar phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dgra bgegs bkug nas bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus gsum gyi gtor ma ri dang rgya mtshor mnyam pa/ khrag gi mchod yon/ dbang po lnga'i me tog tshil chen gyi bdug spos/ zhun chen gyi mar me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas/ rkang gling thod rnga sogs rol mo'i bye brag gzhan yang hūm̐ mthing nag re re las byung ba'i bya nag rta nag g.yag nag lug nag khyi nag mi nag rnams dbang po rdzogs shing rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag gzig go khrab/ gos dar la sogs pa phyi nang gi dam rdzas rnams dngos su 'byor ba dang / yid kyi sprul pa/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral la sogs pa dam can rgya mtsho mnyes par byed pa'i mchod pa'i sprin phung nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra ā brta ya/ ā brta ya hoḥ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ swā hā/ rol cha rnams dkrol zhing bsur chen gyi dud pa btang / g.yab dar nag pos g.yab cing / gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad brjod do/ /hūm̐ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes phrin las kun/ /gcig tu bsdus nas ma rungs tshar gcod phyir/ /drag po'i skur ston rdo rje nag po che/ /dam tshig dgongs la gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/

/gang gi rang bzhin mkha' ltar kun khyab kyang / /drag mo'i tshul ston rdo rje nam gru ma/ /sum cu rtsa gsum de bī ko ṭa dang / /u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gnas nas 'dir gshegs shig /byang shar ha ha dgod pa'i dur khrod du/ /zhing skyong dbang phyug chen po'i rnam 'phrul mchog /drag shul stobs ldan dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa/ /yum chen 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /dur khrod bdag po sha za yab yum dang / /gnod sbyin lcam dral las mkhan yongs kyi gtso/ /mon bu pu tra bha ṭa ral gcig ma/ /ru 'dren sde bzhi la sogs gnas 'dir gshegs/ /gzhan yang phyogs skyong zhing skyong lha klu dang / /'jigs byed gza' chen rgyu skar rgyal chen bzhi/ /snang srid lha srin dregs pa sde brgyad rnams/ /mchod gtor bzhes slad gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ mahā kā li de byai/ badz+ra tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐ mtshan nyid ldan pa'i gzhal yas dam pa 'dir/ /dam tshig can gyi rnal 'byor bdag cag rnams/ /dam rdzas mchod gtor 'dod yon sna tshogs kyis/ /thugs dam bskang phyir brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /ro bcud brgya ldan gser skyems gtsang ma dang / /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i rak+ta'i mchod yon 'di/ /dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /byon skyems dam par 'bul gyis dges par rol/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ mahā kā li de byai/ badz+ra tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ā sa na tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ gtor sngags rnams tshar gsum brjod/ phyi mchod nang mchod dbul/ hūm̐ bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyi nang gi /mchod gtor mthun pa'i dam rdzas legs 'bul gyis/ /thugs dam dgongs la brtse zhing rab dges pas/ /zag med bde ba bskyed phyir bzhes su gsol/ /mtshan ldan thod pa dkar po yangs pa'i nang /

/dam nyams bsgral ba'i sha rus don snying lnga/ /'bru sna sgron ma lcags kyu ye shes lnga/ /byin rlabs bzhed dgu'i gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /dgra bgegs srog rtsa'i khrag gi ar+ghaṃ dang / /mig sogs dbang po lnga yi me tog dang / /gu gul tshil chen sbyar ba'i bdug spos sprin/ /zhun chen dmar nag bsres pa'i sgron me sbar/ /khrag zhag mkhris pa'i dri chab rgya mtsho dang / /dmar nag spel ba'i bshos bu'i zhal zas mchog /rkang gling thod rnga la sogs rol mo'i tshogs/ /snyan brjid 'gying ba'i dbyangs kyi nga ro sogs/ /mgon po 'khor bcas dges pas bzhes su gsol/ /mi mgo'i rtsig pa lcang lo'i kha bad can/ rgyu ma'i dra phyed zhing lpags bla bre bres/ /mi ro'i rgyal mtshan glo snying 'phan tshar byas/ keṃ rus thog phub bse yi sgo glegs la/ /gnam lcags gzer btab khro chu'i ra bas bskor/ /me rlung 'khrug pa'i drag po'i gnas khang 'di/ /bstan srung 'khor dang bcas la 'bul bar bgyi/ /hūm̐ myur mgyogs rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan rta mchog dang / mig sman ltar gnag g.yag rgod zhol chen dang / /lug nag spyi dkar yid 'ong brgya phrag dang / /khro gnyer mche ba rab gtsigs khyi nag dang / /mon pa nag po dung gi rna cha can/ /lcags kyi mchu sder gser mig 'khyil ba yi/ /bya khyung rgyal po bya nag stong gis bskor/ /dre'u dmar nag bong bu gwa dmar dang / /seng ge glang chen ma he stag gzig dang / /dred dang 'phar ba spyang ki ce spyang sogs/ /dbang po kun tshang yid 'phrog dar snas brgyan/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la dbul bar bgyi/ /yid bzhin nor bu bum bzang dpag bsam shing / /'dod 'jo'i ba dang rgyal srid rin chen bdun/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad 'dod yon rnam pa lnga/ /gser dngul byu ru la sogs rin chen tshogs/ /dar zab gos sogs bgo ba'i cha byad dang / /ja dang ka ra la sogs ro bcud ldan/ /ga bur gur gum la sogs dri mchog dang /

/ha ri ta ka la sogs sman sna'i tshogs/ /nas 'bras gro sran 'bru sna dpag med dang / /khrab rmog phub chen la sogs go cha dang / /ral gri mdung sogs mtshon cha'i bye brag dang / /stag gzig gung dang dom dred lpags pa'i tshogs/ /rin chen rus pa mi mgo sbrul rgyan sogs/ /thun mong mchod rdzas nam mkha'i khams gang ba/ /dpal mgon lcam dral 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /hūm̐ khyad par brten pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba ni/ /gri lcags gri gug thod khrag gaṇ+ḍi dang / /ral gri rtse gsum spu gri dam shing dang / /thod phreng la sogs phyag mtshan sna tshogs 'bul/ /pho rten rnga ma dkar nag dar tshon dang / /mo rten nal bu'i rgyal mtshan sha khrag phud/ /las mkhan rten du stag gzig ras ma la/ /gser g.yus spras shing bse yi byang bu dang / /bse zhal chang phud rin chen brdar ba dang / /gzhan yang bsnyen sgrub las sbyor dam rdzas tshogs/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin dpag med rnams/ /gus shing nye ba'i tshul gyis 'bul lags na/ /dam tshig rjes dgongs brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /thun mong khyad par gsang ba'i rten rnams kyis/ /rdo rje gur gyi mgon po'i thugs dam bskang / /dpal ldan lha mo e ka dza ṭī dang / 'dod khams dbang phyug nam gru'i༞ zhing skyong gtso bo zhal bzhi'i༞ yum chen bzhi dang srog bdud shel mig can/ /'khor gyi shan pa gri thogs༞ las mkhan gnod sbyin yab yum༞ pu tra bha ṭa sring mo khrag mig ma/ /sgo ma ru 'dren sde bzhi'i༞ dur khrod bdag po gtsang ris mgon po dang / sprul pa'i khyung chen sogs kyi༞ nag po stong dang nag mo sha za 'bum/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro bye ba'i༞ snang zhing srid pa'i lha srin sde brgyad dang / /gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa'i thugs dam bskang / /de nas bshags pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐ byin rlabs thugs rje'i bdag nyid bla ma dang / /dngos grub myur du stsol mdzad yi dam lha/ /bar chad kun sel bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs/

/bdag la gsan cing dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /khyed rnams rang bzhin cir yang ma grub kyang / /log rtog 'khrul pa'i dbang gis de dang der/ /zhen cing 'dzin pas bden par sgro btags te/ /ma rig las ngan bsags pa mthol lo bshags/ /snang ba'i ngo bo bskyed rim lha yin kyang / /ma dag tha mal 'dzin pas sgrib gyur te/ /bskyed rim bsgom dang sngags kyi bzlas brjod la/ /g.yel zhing bag med gyur pa༞ chos rnams rang bzhin stong zhing bdag med kyang / /gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i bag chags zhen pa yis/ /rdzogs rim bde chen phyag rgya chen po la/ /kun rtog dri mas gos pa༞ bsrung bar bya rgyu'i dbang bzhi'i dam tshig rnams/ /le lo brjed ngas bag med dbang gyur pas/ /mnyam gzhag rjes spyod bza' bsrung mi 'bral ba'i/ /dam tshig nyams dang 'gal ba mthol lo bshags/ /khyad par chos skyong bsrung ma'i sku gsung thugs/ /dam tshig nyams chags mchod gtor chag pa dang / /bsnyen sgrub ma nus bag med spyod pa yis/ /gtsang sbra chung dang 'bags btsog phud nyams shing / /rgyu chung bsham nyes dam rdzas ma tshang dang / /sku yi rnam pa mi gsal sngags ma dag /gnyid dang bre mo'i gtam gyis dus 'da' zhing / /ting 'dzin lhod dang bsgom la mi brtson pas/ /tha mal yid g.yeng 'dzab bzlas nyung ba sogs/ /mdor na lus ngag yid kyi spyod pa rnams/ /rang bzhin bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba/ /bgyis dang bgyis bstsal bgyid pa'i las rnams dang / /lung du ma bstan nongs pa gang bgyis kun/ /rab tu nongs shing 'gyod pas bshags lags na/ /dmigs med thugs rje'i klong du bzod par gsol/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /'phrin las bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ gson cig dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas kun/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod gtor dam rdzas rnams/ /dges pa'i tshul gyis tshim par rol nas kyang / /bdag la brtse bas da ni phrin las mdzod/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang /

/bstan 'dzin dam pa rnams kyang sku tshe brtan/ /'jig rten khams kun bde zhing lo phyugs legs/ /chos srid dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje 'chang dang mal lo sa skya pa'i/ rtsa brgyud bla mas bka' bsgo dam bzhag ltar/ /ji ltar gsol ba'i 'dod don kun 'grub cing / /rnal 'byor bdag gi mgon dang sdong grogs mdzod/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad gdon rims dang dgra bgegs gnod pa sogs/ /mi mthun bar chad nye bar 'tshe ba rnams/ /myur du zhi zhing med par mdzad du gsol/ /mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams ye shes dang / /dpal 'byor 'khor dang longs spyod dbang phyug sogs/ /legs pa'i yon tan mtha' dag dbyar mtsho ltar/ /gang zhig rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ /lha klu gnod sbyin 'byung po mthu bo che/ /bsod nams stobs ldan mi yi dbang po rnams/ /thams cad gus shing 'dud pas dbang bsdus nas/ /rnam grol byang chub lam du bkri bar mdzod/ /gal te zhi bas mi thul de dag la/ /khyed kyi phrin las mthu rtsal dpung bskyed la/ /drag po'i stobs kyis myur du tshar bcad de/ /bdag gi bsam don 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /hūm̐ dpal 'bar ma hā kā la mthu ma chung / /lha mo nag mo thugs rje ma g.yel bar/ /lha chen nag po gdong bzhi dbyings nas bzhengs/ /ma mo mkha' 'gros cho 'phrul sna tshogs thongs/ /pho nya las mkhan drag po'i stobs bskyed nas/ /ru 'dren sde bzhi sde brgyad dmag sna drongs/ /snang srid lha srin gdug pa'i dmag la chos/ /do nub bzlog bsgyur phrin las grub par mdzod/ /srid pa'i khram kha lha 'dre'i dmag sna dang / /tshe zor yungs zor gshin rje'i 'khrul 'khor dang / /ma mo'i byol kha klu yi mnan gtad dang / /the rang bsri brku rgyal 'gong thog brdzis bzlog /rmi lam mtshan ngan phyogs dus ngan pa dang / /gzhan gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa'i rbod gtong dang /

/ltas ngan ye 'brog 'khon grib nad rims dang / /lo zla zhag dang za ma'i skeg ngan bzlog /rlung gi gshed bzhi mo rtsis ngan pa dang / /gza' dang rgyu skar thog ser 'bebs pa dang / /btsan bdud dmu dang sa bdag gnyan rnams kyi/ /cho 'phrul ltas ngan gnod pa thams cad bzlog /gzhan yang bdag la sdang byed dgra bo rnams/ /zungs chings khug la bsnun cing sdigs par mdzod/ /bsregs bcad btubs nas sha khrag rus pa rnams/ /zhal du bzhes shing rnam shes dbyings su sgrol/ /mdor na zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rnams/ /gang bcol thogs pa med par bsgrub pa dang / /sa lam bgrod nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa/ /myur du 'grub pa'i phrin las rgya cher mdzod/ /de nas bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung byas la/ gtor ma steng du dbul/ bkra shis brjod nas rten rnams gshegs gsol brtan bzhugs gang 'os dang / smon lam rgya cher byas te/ rjes mi mngon par bsdu'o/ /tshul 'di snar thang chos kyi grwa'i/ /stong dpon ngag gi dbang po mchog /don grub rdo rjes rab bskul te/ /dpal ldan sa skya lo tsās sbyar/ /maṅgal ka l+yā ṇa brdan+tu/ /e waṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ dpal sa skya pa'i bka' srung rnams kyi bskang gso mnyes byed 'chi med sgra dbyangs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 7
